notes: You still owe me a coffee.
Don't do anything brave without me.

axis: Checked every seal twice, and was thanked for it.
Has a notebook full of things worth a second look.
Kept a seat free at every long table.
Said the true thing when it needed saying.
epi.plain: Kept the ship running, quietly and well. The logs say so, in small handwriting.
head: Seven ships, seven crews, every one accounted for.
Seven ships, one planet, and every seal held.
story: a_window_hail
Set an answer running weeks early. Still has the printout of the first OK.
a_window_quiet
Lost the vote to answer, then carried the answer the last stretch in person.
m_carrier
Still scans the old channel every night, out of habit.
m_reveal
Got the lighthouse wrong and the keeper right. Kept the drawing.
m_theory
Ran out of blue marker in the first month on Mars.
a_list
Got an answer from every name on the list, and read each one aloud, pauses included.
g_news
Added one name to the list on Mars, and keeps it current.
p_live_call
Kept a list of who was at the table.
a_song
Taught the fifth bar to six people who had guessed it wrong.
p_music
Never told anyone the song's name.
p_garden_sprout
Strapped the seedling beside the seat, and planted it in the lee of Cargo 2.
p_garden_none
Carried a seed that never came up all the way to Mars, to plant it properly.
p_garden_plant
Still says good night to the plants, out loud, on Mars.
letter_open
Saved a letter for the hard day. Its last line is in no log anywhere.
letter_worn
Wore a letter thin at the fold, and read its last line aloud at Mars.
a_letter
Read the last line of a letter aloud, at Mars.
dose_swap
Slept between the water tanks, because someone had a better dosimeter.
dose_ok
Took the bunk by the habitat's water wall, out of habit now.
a_last_night
Sleeps by water, still, and sleeps well.
l_dose
Topped the fleet's dose chart, and flew on.
m_flash1
Kept both timestamps. Still has them.
m_overlay
Put two traces side by side. Didn't look away.
sharpie2
Knows a handwriting from Starbase on sight.
l_stash
Found the first of the notes.
crisis_eva
Landed with a wrist that bends again.
